g.text: PRODUCTIVE · PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT · PART 2.0 · THE MACHINE AND THE ROOM
The room is the rated enclosure your attention runs inside — the cheapest fixes seal the biggest leaks.
the enclosure caps everything above it
each port a permanent channel — eyes learn where to look
past the cone they stop helping
∷ more visible surface = fewer switches, each one a context rebuild · Part 1.1
∷ heat steals the energy the brain spends on attention · PLOS Med 2018
attention reorients to anything that changes
SSD NON-NEGOTIABLE (HDD→SSD beats a faster CPU)
STAND UP = A CONTEXT SWITCH IN DISGUISE
∷ fewer competitors, the target wins · McMains & Kastner 2011
arm · standing toggle · a real chair
each cheap fix = a plug that returns the current to the rail
DERATING CEILING — caps output, however hard you push
grinding through the 2 pm heat and blaming your willpower
THE CHEAPEST FIXES SEAL THE BIGGEST LEAKS
height = friction sealed · order of leverage, not price
vs DISTRACTION, the main threat → Part 1.1
THE SETUP DISAPPEARS. ONLY THE WORK IS LEFT.
Seal the leaks, not your willpower — commission the bay, then stop noticing it.
COGNITIVE = hardware · LEARNING = software · PRODUCTIVITY = the OS
Part 2.0 of 7 · Productivity Enhancement · the Productive pillar
